areas.title: Quantum error correction
areas.blurb: Topological and qLDPC codes: how they detect errors, how they compute, and how fairly their decoders are compared.

areas.title: Quantum algorithms and quantum machine learning
areas.blurb: Variational eigensolvers on hardware, quantum reservoirs and kernels, and machine learning that probes quantum random number generators.

areas.title: LLM reasoning and applied machine learning
areas.blurb: Test-time reasoning for language models, and ensemble forecasting.

areas.title: Quantum topology
areas.blurb: Bonahon–Wong–Yang quantum invariants of surface diffeomorphisms and their volume conjectures.

papers.title: Topological phases of matter, quantum error correction, and topological twists
papers.summary: Reviews anyon condensation and lattice twists through tensor categories, and gives a new explicit error detection and correction algorithm for the doubled semion model.

papers.title: Lifted surgery for non-Abelian two-block group-algebra codes
papers.summary: Extends lifted code surgery to non-Abelian group-algebra qLDPC codes, bounds the gain, and finds codes that measure more logicals in fewer rounds.

papers.title: Fair Decoder Baselines and Rigorous Finite-Size Scaling for Bivariate Bicycle Codes on the Quantum Erasure Channel
papers.summary: Shows that unfair decoder baselines distort bivariate bicycle code comparisons on erasure noise, and estimates an asymptotic threshold near 0.488 by finite-size scaling.

papers.title: Efficient variational quantum eigensolver methodologies on quantum processors
papers.summary: Compares adaptive VQE, Tetris-ADAPT-VQE and entanglement forging for the BeH2 ground state on IBM hardware, with TREX and ZNE error mitigation.

papers.title: An architectural capacity ceiling, not a barren plateau: why a fixed-encoding variational quantum circuit cannot fit the Lorenz-63 attractor
papers.summary: Argues a four-qubit variational circuit fails on Lorenz-63 because its time encoding caps accessible frequencies, not because of barren plateaus.

papers.title: When Classical Baselines Are Tuned as Carefully as the Quantum Model, Does Quantum Reservoir Computing Still Win?
papers.summary: With equally tuned classical baselines, two commonly cited quantum reservoir advantages vanish in exact simulations of up to eleven qubits.

papers.title: A Quantum Reservoir Architecture for Chaotic Forecasting and a Test of Whether Its High Dimension Helps
papers.summary: Gives a reproducible quantum reservoir recipe for chaotic forecasting and a diagnostic for whether its large feature space genuinely helps.

papers.title: Quantum Kernels for Parity-Structured Classification: A Hybrid Pipeline
papers.venue: 2026 IEEE 19th Dallas Circuits and Systems Conference (DCAS), pp. 1-6
papers.summary: A ZZ quantum kernel beats a binary-encoding classical ablation on high-order parity (XOR) classification, with the margin growing with parity complexity.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Driven Quantum Hacking of CHSH-Based QKD: Exploiting Entropy Vulnerabilities in Self-testing Protocols
papers.venue: QUEST-IS 2025, Communications in Computer and Information Science vol. 2744, Springer, pp. 140-149
papers.summary: Uses a qGAN, bias detection and neural classifiers on Rigetti and IonQ hardware to detect weak random number generators that could enable attacks on CHSH-based QKD.

papers.title: Adaptive Graph of Thoughts: Test-Time Adaptive Reasoning Unifying Chain, Tree, and Graph Structures
papers.summary: A test-time LLM reasoning method that recursively breaks a query into a graph of subproblems, expanding only hard ones; up to 46.2% gain on GPQA.

papers.title: Modeling Sea Level Rise Using Ensemble Techniques: Impacts on Coastal Adaptation, Freshwater Ecosystems, Agriculture and Infrastructure
papers.summary: A weighted SARIMAX, LSTM and exponential-smoothing ensemble forecasts sea level rise on the US East and Gulf coasts to 2103 and assesses ecological and infrastructure impacts.

papers.title: Generalized Bonahon–Wong–Yang volume conjecture of quantum invariants of surface diffeomorphisms I: the figure eight knot complement
papers.summary: Proposes a generalized Bonahon-Wong-Yang volume conjecture tied to hyperbolic cone structures and proves it for the figure-eight knot complement (word LR).

papers.title: The Bonahon–Wong–Yang volume conjecture for the four-puncture sphere
papers.summary: Computes the Bonahon-Wong-Yang invariant for four-puncture sphere diffeomorphisms and verifies the volume conjecture for these bundles under technical conditions.

papers.title: A Study of Bonahon–Wong–Yang Quantum Invariants
papers.summary: Doctoral thesis in mathematics, written under the supervision of Prof. Tian Yang.

papers.title: An intermediate conjecture between Goldbach and Dubner: every even number is the sum of a prime and a twin prime
papers.summary: Studies the conjecture, proves a conditional positive-density result, and verifies it numerically up to 10^14.
papers.claim: The conjecture itself is not proved. The density theorem assumes a lower bound of Hardy-Littlewood order for twin primes; the statement is checked by computer for every even number from 6 to 10^14.
